alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A staircase room. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes strides in from the left with a proud stretch, a spotlight follows it, and a bell rings. On the right a navy figure sits looking down at a phone. The ink-black figure narrows its eyes, walks out and enters again, taller, with a louder bell. It does it a third time, taller still. The navy figure finally looks up with narrowed eyes, unimpressed, and then goes back to the phone. The text stays: me entering a room that was not waiting for me.
